dict.string: Orbi listens only while you hold Right Option, or after you double-tap it, so you can talk to it.
Orbi reads what is on screen and uses the mouse and keyboard for you. It never acts in password managers, Keychain Access, System Settings, Terminal, iTerm2 or Chrome.
Orbi takes screenshots of your main display to see what you see. Passwords, card numbers and verification codes are blacked out before anything leaves your Mac.
